description: Spoken parts of fixtures/host.wav (16 kHz mono, generated with espeak-ng). `answers` is the questions.json label the part answers, or null when it only talks around one. Phase 4's matcher must mark mainnet and bridge answered and leave unlock open.

parts.text: Great question. Mainnet ships in Q1, and the public testnet opens in December.
On token unlocks, we care a lot about fairness for the community, and we are working through the details with our partners.
And yes, there will be a bridge from testnet to mainnet on launch day.
